nodes.description: Private owner address of UniswapExchange, set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the privileged account in all admin guards.
Public mapping of token balances updated by transferFrom and batchSend without SafeMath.
Public nested mapping of allowances, written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Private per-address counter of sale transfers, incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Private mapping of addresses whitelisted to bypass the sale condition check in ensure.
Private minimum sale amount set in init with an unchecked multiplication.
Private maximum sale amount set in init with an unchecked multiplication.
Private per-address sale cap set in init and read by condition.
Privileged trade address, whitelisted in ensure and settable only by owner.
Public total supply of the token, assigned in the constructor.
Constant public decimals value (18) used to scale supply and sale limits.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as the sender.
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance and balances and increments _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal whitelist check that computes the Uniswap pair and falls back to condition().
Internal view sale-limit validator reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall on a user supplied address and bytes.
Owner-only initializer that sets sale limits using unchecked multiplications.
Owner-only batch distribution that multiplies _value by array length and debits owner balance.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress state variable.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation via keccak256.
Payable constructor writing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, balanceOf and allowance.
Caller-supplied address used for authorization checks and as the acting account.
Arbitrary low-level delegatecall in delegate() to an attacker-influenced address and calldata.
uint total = _value * _tos.length performed without SafeMath, allowing integer overflow.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total executed without SafeMath protection.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value raw subtraction without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value raw subtraction without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value raw addition without SafeMath.
token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) multiplications without SafeMath.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the sender into transferFrom by transfer.
_to parameter flows into transfer.
_value parameter flows into transfer.
transfer calls transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
msg.sender is compared to _from and indexes the allowance mapping.
_from parameter governs allowance and balance debits.
_to parameter governs balance credit.
_value parameter governs allowance and balance math.
transferFrom calls ensure to enforce whitelist and sale condition.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf via unchecked subtraction and addition.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
allowance subtraction without SafeMath in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_from] subtraction without SafeMath in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_to] addition without SafeMath in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
_spender parameter indexes allowance in approve.
_value parameter is written as the new allowance.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
_from parameter is compared against whitelisted addresses in ensure.
_to parameter is compared against the owner in ensure.
_value parameter is forwarded to condition in ensure.
local Uniswap pair address computed inside ensure is used in the whitelist comparison.
ensure falls back to condition for non-whitelisted callers.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap V2 pair address.
ensure reads owner for the whitelist comparison.
ensure reads canSale[_from] for the whitelist check.
_from parameter indexes _onSaleNum in condition.
_value parameter is compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
condition reads _saleNum to bound sale counts.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from].
condition reads _minSale.
condition reads _maxSale.
delegate is gated only by the require(msg.sender == owner) check.
parameter a is the delegatecall target address.
parameter b is attacker-influenced calldata for delegatecall.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall on user-supplied inputs.
init is gated only by the require(msg.sender == owner) check.
saleNum parameter sets _saleNum in init.
token parameter sets _minSale in init.
maxToken parameter sets _maxSale in init.
init writes _minSale using an unchecked multiplication.
init writes _maxSale using an unchecked multiplication.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
init multiplies token and maxToken by 10**decimals without SafeMath.
batchSend is gated only by the require(msg.sender == owner) check.
_tos array is iterated and used as recipients in batchSend.
_value is multiplied by the array length in batchSend.
local total is used for the balance check and debit in batchSend.
local loop index i drives the batchSend iteration.
loop-local _to is the credited address inside batchSend.
batchSend mutates balanceOf entries without SafeMath.
batchSend multiplies _value by _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
setTradeAddress is gated only by the require(msg.sender == owner) check.
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
factory parameter is hashed into the pair address in pairFor.
tokenA parameter participates in pair ordering and hashing.
tokenB parameter participates in pair ordering and hashing.
constructor assigns msg.sender as owner and initial balance holder.
_name parameter is written to name in the constructor.
_symbol parameter is written to symbol in the constructor.
_supply parameter determines totalSupply and initial balance.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
constructor sets the name state variable.
constructor sets the symbol state variable.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
constructor grants infinite allowance to the Uniswap router address.
